messages:
Hannah: Quick ping — PR #5173 (kv-eviction-hotfix) is up. Fixes a race when prefetched slots are freed; low-risk but touches the runtime eviction path. Can someone from runtime + infra + security give quick eyes? Planning a canary tonight at 01:00 UTC. /cc @Marco @Priya
Marco: Looks small. I'll take runtime review now. Any repro or test plan?
Hannah: Test plan is in the PR description: added unit + integration tests. Repro (local):
```
./bin/stress_eviction --preload --threads=8 --duration=60
```
Expect no OOB and stable cache hit metrics. Also added a canary checklist in the PR.
Priya: Security quick check: confirm this doesn't touch KMS/secret paths or change audit events?
Hannah: No KMS or secrets. Purely eviction bookkeeping and a metric counter. Assertion behind feature flag for safety.
Joel: Infra check: any node / kernel config or scheduler tweak required? If not, infra can sign off.
Marco: Runtime LGTM modulo one nit: lock-order comment would help future readers. I'll push a one-line follow-up if that's OK.
Priya: :thumbsup: security ok from my side, no data-plane surface area changed.
Joel: Infra ok. No config changes required; scheduler behavior unchanged.
Hannah: Thanks all. Canary scheduled for 01:00 UTC. deploy-bot — please queue the canary and tag reference to PR#5173.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary job queued for 2026-03-18T01:00:00Z by @Hannah — job id canary-5173-20260318
Hannah: Appreciate the fast turnaround :heart: I'll merge once Marco's tiny follow-up lands, unless folks prefer me to merge and Marco opens the follow-up separately. Thoughts?
Marco: I'll open the follow-up in ~10–15m. Feel free to merge after CI passes.
Hannah: Got it — merging after green and follow-up opened. Will watch canary metrics and ping if anything abnormal (latency/error-rate).
Security-bot: security-bot: Noted — will run audit rules post-canary and report any anomalies.
